description: v0.1 capability-token sink effect receipt (M4). Sink consumes the token preimage from the gateway's M3 (rejecting on nullifier replay), executes the action, and signs an EffectReceipt binding the consumed token to the result. The (M1, M3, M4) tuple is the full attestation record. Search keywords: capability token, effect receipt, M4, sink attestation.

challenge.description: Original SinkChallenge from M1 (for binding verification)

expected_delegation_chain_root.description: If omitted, falls back to the receipt's own root

gateway_public_key.description: Used to verify M3 before consuming the token

name: aps_capability_sign_effect
